case_name: Rishi Pal v. State of Uttarakhand

pages.text:
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
Rishi Pal ... Appellant
versus
State of Uttarakhand ... Respondent
Coram: T.S. Thakur, Gyan Sudha Misra, JJ.
Judgment Dated: 08 February 2013

THAKUR, J.:
1. This appeal examines the distinction between simple theft under Section 379, theft with preparation for causing death or hurt under Section 382, and robbery under Section 390/392 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. Ingredients of Section 382 IPC: Section 382 provides rigorous punishment up to ten years where the offender commits theft having made preparation for causing death, hurt, or restraint, or fear of death, hurt or restraint, in order to the committing of such theft, or in order to effect his escape after committing theft, or in order to retain property taken by theft.

3. Decision: The carrying of concealed weapons (knives, firearms) by the thieves during the nocturnal raid on the warehouse established preparation to cause hurt if intercepted. Conviction under Section 382 IPC affirmed.
